chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Ya'qub ibn Yazid, from Yahya ibn al-Mubarak, from 'Abd Allah ibn Jabalah, from Abi Jamilah, from Ishaq ibn 'Ammar and Sama'ah, from Abi Basir, who said:
I said: One who consumes usury after the proof has been established? He said: “He is disciplined; then if he returns, he is disciplined; then if he returns, he is killed.”

key_terms.أُدِّبَ: he was disciplined or punished again
key_terms.الرِّبَا: usury; unlawful increase in financial transactions
key_terms.الْبَيِّنَةِ: clear proof or conclusive evidence established against a person
key_terms.يُؤَدَّبُ: he is disciplined or punished with a discretionary penalty

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on someone who consumes usury after the proof has been established against him?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning one who consumes usury after the proof has been established against him. It indicates escalating punishment for repeated persistence in this prohibited act, showing the gravity of usury in Islamic law.
